$comment: Time-bounded acceptances for dependency advisories that the audit's own production-graph classifier proved not-runtime-reachable. This file is deliberately empty in the steady state: raising a narrow version floor in the overrides block of pnpm-workspace.yaml remains the normal remedy, and a disposition is only for a build-only advisory with no compatible patched release. A disposition never asserts reachability, it only records the human argument and the deadline; the gate refuses it outright when the classifier reports runtime-reachable or unknown, when the package name does not match, when the advisory has left the report, or when the review date has passed. See docs/SECURITY.md.

dispositions.reason: braces <=3.0.3 (GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm) and sprintf-js <=1.1.3 (GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c) have no published patched release; 3.0.3 and 1.1.3 are the newest versions on the registry.
dispositions.removalCriteria: Raise a narrow override floor to braces >=3.0.4 and sprintf-js >=1.1.4 as soon as upstream publishes them, then delete this disposition; renew only after re-checking the registry and the audit classifier.
dispositions.reachabilityArgument: Both packages enter only through desktop build tooling: braces via @electron-forge/core>fast-glob>micromatch and sprintf-js via @electron/get>global-agent>roarr used to download Electron during packaging. Neither is in a production manifest graph, the built web bundle, or the packaged desktop asar, and their inputs are repository-controlled globs and log format strings.
